verdict.rationale: Gemini's own docs describe a scheduling feature that lets users set up recurring actions (daily/weekly/monthly) such as a daily news digest, which matches the recurring-task part of the story (gemini-docs-8, gemini-docs-48). However, the evidence never explicitly confirms one-off (single-run) scheduled tasks, nor is there any independent/hands-on report validating that results reliably come back to the user as described. missing for 10: explicit one-off task scheduling, independent/hands-on confirmation of the scheduling feature working in practice.
